Table: EDW_HR_AGE_BAND_M

Description:
Primary Key: EDW_HR_AGE_BAND_M_PK
  1. AGBD_AGE_BAND_PK_KEY
Comments

This is the Age Band dimension table. This is a denormalized star table and contains records for the lowest level of the dimension and every level above.
The Age dimension delivers a number of age bands that enable you to group people of a similar age. Age bands are measured in years and months and are configurable. The Age dimension is referenced by several facts, usually to record the age of a person at the time of a transaction.

Description:

  1. ASGT_ASSIGNMENT_PK_KEY
Comments

This is the Assignment dimension table. This is a denormalized star table and contains records for lowest level of the dimension and every level above.
People can sometimes hold several positions within an Enterprise simultaneously; this can be simplified using the concept of assignments, as each person always has at least one assignment. Assignments allow you to describe a person's work relationship within the Enterprise.

  1. JBLV_JOB_PK_KEY
Comments

This is the Job dimension table. This is a denormalized star table and contains records for the lowest level of the dimension and every level above.
A job defines the role and responsibility held by an employee within the enterprise. Jobs are independent of individual organizations. An employee can have one job for each assignment they hold, and may hold several assignments simultaneously.

Table: EDW_HR_MVMNT_TYP_M

Description:
Primary Key: EDW_HR_MVMNT_TYP_M_PK
  1. WMVT_MOVEMENT_TYPE_PK_KEY
Comments

This is the Movement Type dimension table. This is a denormalized star table and contains records for the lowest level of the dimension and every level above.
Any workforce losses or gains, including internal transfers, are classified as workforce movements. Additionally, workforce movements also include the changes that occur as people move within the recruitment or separation stages (for example, from the offer stage to the accept stage of recruitment, or from the separation notified to separation accepted stage of separation).

Table: EDW_HR_PERSON_M

Description:
Primary Key: EDW_HR_PERSON_M_PK
  1. ASGN_ASSIGNMENT_PK_KEY
Comments

This is Person dimension table. This is a denormalized star table and contains records for the lowest level of the dimension and every level above.
The Person dimension is used to group together the attributes that describe the characteristics of a person, for example, name, nationality, date of birth. It contains information about all people related to the Enterprise including employees, applicants and contacts.

This is the Recruitment Activity dimension table. This is a denormalized star table and contains records for the lowest level of the dimension and every level above.
This dimension shows the recruitment activity and recruitment activity type associated with an application. An activity type is a broad classification for recruitment activities, for example, advertisements, recruitment fairs, recruitment campaigns.

Table: EDW_HR_SERVICE_M

Description:
Primary Key: EDW_HR_SERVICE_M_PK
  1. SRBD_SERVICE_BAND_PK_KEY
Comments

This is Period of Work dimension table. This is a denormalized star table and contains records for the lowest level of the dimension and every level above.
Period of Work bands group employee length of service information into a number of specific ranges; these are then used to group employees who have worked for the enterprise for a similar length of time. Period of Work bands are measured in years, months, weeks, and days, and are configurable.

Comments

This is Internal Organization dimension table. This is a denormalized star table and contains records for lowest level of the dimension and every level above.
Organizations and Organization hierarchies are used to describe the structures that exist within an Enterprise. In addition to particular organizations, the Internal Organization dimension enables you to access Primary organization hierarchies, Operational hierarchies and the relationships between Business Groups, legal entities, operating units, and organizations.

Table: HR_EDW_WRK_ACTVTY_F

Description:
Comments

This is the Workforce Activity fact table. While working for an Enterprise, employees may change job, grade, organization, location, and position. Employees may also move in or out of the Enterprise (recruitment or separation). These changes reveal overall patterns of change within the Enterprise and can help you to plan future staffing requirements and analyze the possible reasons for these changes.

Table: HR_EDW_WRK_CMPSTN_F

Description:
Comments

This is the Workforce Composition fact table.This fact examines the available workforce makeup at specific points in time by all relevant dimensions. Snapshots of the workforce are taken at regular intervals; the collection process controls the interval between snapshots.
The purpose of the Workforce Composition fact is to show where workforce is deployed, and how deployment changes over time. By analyzing snapshots of an enterprise over time, various trends can be identified.

Table: HR_EDW_WRK_RCTMNT_F

Description:
Comments

This is the Workforce Recruitment Stage fact table. This fact contains information about each stage of the recruitment process, from application to hire and eventual separation. There is one row in the fact table for each application (one per applicant assignment) and one row for each employee assignment (for current employees who may be hired directly without following the recruitment process).

Table: HR_EDW_WRK_SPRTN_F

Description:
Comments

This is the Workforce Separation fact table. This fact analyses the different stages of the employee separation process. There is one row in the fact table for each assignment held by each employee in the Enterprise. As an employee moves through the separation process, the assignment rows are updated.
